title: SmartSubs Pro v2.9.12
notes: A new style gallery: pick a look and get the animation, font, colors, effects, position and timing in one click, with a live preview on every card. Ten looks to start, from Viral Karaoke to Comic Pop and Bebas Cinema, and your own saved presets show their preview too. The installer now adds the caption fonts the looks use (Montserrat, Poppins, Anton, Bebas Neue, Bangers, Luckiest Guy) so DaVinci Resolve can use them. New automatic emoji: turn them on in Style and SmartSubs adds a matching emoji to captions with key words like money, secret or fire, one at a time and never on two captions in a row. The License Agreement now states that all future updates, including major versions, are included at no extra cost.
